Coram: Honourable Mr. Justice Satyavrat Verma
 Oral Order
Heard learned counsel for the petitioners and learned APP.

2. Issue notice to the Opposite Party No. 2 by both modes i.e. registered cover with A/D as well as ordinary post for which requisites etc. must be filed on or before 30-11-2023, failing which the present quashing application shall stand rejected without further reference to the Bench.
3. Put up this case on 29-02-2024.
4.

In the meantime, the order dated 17-5-2017 passed by the learned SDJM, Bhagalpur in connection with Mahila P.S. Case No. 28/2016, whereby cognizance of offences under Section 498A of IPC has been taken, shall remain stayed.

5. Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that earlier the OP No. 2 had instituted Complaint Case No.1353 of Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.46616 of 2017(2) dt.09-11-2023 2011 against her father-in-law and mother-in-law in which her husband was not made an accused, but when the mother-in-law executed will of the property in favour of the son of OP No. 2, thereafter she stopped pursuing the case and the complaint case was dismissed by the learned Magistrate holding that prima facie, no offence is made out.

It is next submitted, six years thereafter, the present FIR came Ashok Kumar Sah vs State Of Bihar And Anr on 9 November, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/67387605/
1 to be instituted against her husband.

opennyai_summary.arguments:
5. Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that earlier the OP No. 2 had instituted Complaint Case No.1353 of Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.46616 of 2017(2) dt.09-11-2023 2011 against her father-in-law and mother-in-law in which her husband was not made an accused, but when the mother-in-law executed will of the property in favour of the son of OP No. 2, thereafter she stopped pursuing the case and the complaint case was dismissed by the learned Magistrate holding that prima facie, no offence is made out.
It is further submitted that the OP No. 2 only with a view to coerce the petitioner and her family members into submission for property is instituting false cases when the marriage of the petitioner with the OP No. 2 was performed in the year 1996 and out of the wedlock, six children were born and the eldest child is 18 years old.
